title: De Lima backs QC task force axing: No authority for ‘utak-Tokhang’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The disbanding of Quezon City’s Task Force Disiplina following the death of three teenagers at the hands of its members is justified, as no authority must be given to agencies…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The disbanding of Quezon City’s Task Force Disiplina following the death of three teenagers at the hands of its members is justified, as no authority must be given to agencies that still have a “Tokhang” mindset, Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima. In a statement on Friday, de Lima said individuals who disregard lives and human rights should not be given the power to implement policies that discipline people. The lawmaker’s remarks came after three teenagers aged 15, 18, and 19 were killed last Monday by a certain “Vin,” a drunk member of the Task Force Disiplina, Quezon City’s […]...
